context:
Goal: lanes message sessions without refusals (your item 301 a), and messages stay inside safe limits.
Problem (risk): with send_message on the allow list, auto mode stops judging its rule "Owner Session Message". That rule limits three forms: an interrupt (priority now), a post to a shared channel, and a message outside your account. No hook checks them. So after #1364, those three go unchecked.
Based on (read): the round-1 reviewer of #1364, 16:51 CST, relayed by batch runner 8.
Departs from: main, where auto mode judges every send_message — #1364 allows all of them.
Meanwhile: runner 8 batches #1364 with the send_message line only.
holds: What still checks the risky send_message forms.

lastAnswer.note: also send a lane to try and fix the judge so we can try and get that back in auto mode overall

options.gain: Lanes message freely, and the three risky forms stay checked.
options.how: A guard on send_message refuses priority now, a shared-channel post, or a target outside your account, unless you typed the act.
options.label: Keep #1364, add a guard

options.gain: Auto mode keeps judging every message.
options.how: Fix auto mode's judge instead, as your 301 note suggested.
options.label: Drop #1364, fix the judge
options.lose: Refusals continue until the judge fix lands.

reply: Done: b, no guard. Correction (17:18 CST): the judge-fix lane did not start. Auto mode refused its brief, because the fix edits settings.json. That needs your typed word, see item 316.
title: Allowing send_message (your item 301 a) also stops checks on three risky message forms: add a guard for them?
why: After #1364, no one checks an interrupt, a shared-channel post or a message outside your account.
